source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.4, printed pages 54-75, in the book's order.

blocks.text: Aap jante hain ke cells ki do basic qismein hain: prokaryotic aur eukaryotic. Tamam bacteria prokaryotes hain. Yeast aur Euglena unicellular (ek cell wale) eukaryotes ki misalen hain. Poday aur janwar multicellular (bohat se cells wale) eukaryotes ki misalen hain. Eukaryotic cells prokaryotic cells se zyada pecheeda (complex) hote hain. Agle paragraphs mein hum cell ke andar ki structures (banawatein) aur un ke kaam parhenge.
